name: near-duplicate
status: exploratory: not part of H3's registered analysis until the near-duplicate arm (P4 in docs/research/preregistration.md, section 'Proposed amendments, not yet registered') is registered by amendment
limits: The oracle estimates the same Jaccard similarity the lint estimates, with other hash functions: agreement checks the implementation, not whether the lint finds what a person would call a duplicate (card R2's decision, docs/log/2026-11-21-r2-decision-l5-oracle-is-agreement.md).
Precision and recall are on the tier's own two fixtures, written by the card's author with the vetoes in mind: they say the fixtures pass, nothing about natural memory.
Small: the fault catalogue holds 66 compared pairs, so the Wilson intervals are wide.
English only: the number and polarity vetoes read English weekday and month names and English negations.
Off in every registered preset and condition: no registered arm runs near-duplicate-tier.
